audience: sales teams that manage accounts, opportunities, quotations and activities in ClarityCRM

useCases.title: Review opportunities and their close dates
useCases.text: List opportunities with their amounts and close dates, using search text or a filter.

useCases.title: Find a contact or an account by search text
useCases.text: Search contacts and accounts by name. Open one record for its full details.

useCases.title: Update the fields of a lead
useCases.text: Find a lead by search text, then change its fields. The given fields overwrite the stored values.

useCases.title: Close an activity in the follow-up list
useCases.text: List activities with their status. Change the status of one activity, for example to completed.

useCases.title: Create an account for a new company
useCases.text: Create an account record for a company. The tool writes a new record with the ClarityCRM field names.

useCases.title: Read invoices and sales orders
useCases.text: List invoices and sales orders with search text or a filter. Open one invoice by its id.
